title: Clearer text and roomier phone layouts
summary: Improves reading sizes, long-name layouts and larger-text controls across the phone interface.
changes: Uses 16px body text and 14px supporting text in the shared interface type scale.
Gives hero duty and break details wider columns, with a separate full-width colleague or coverage row.
Makes roster names and allocation labels easier to read on narrow phones.
Keeps forms readable without focus zoom and replaces the clipped hero clock explanation with a concise timing summary.
